about_the_game:
Get ready to race! This arcade-style racing game delivers fast-paced action, colorful tracks, and a fun singleplayer experience against smart AI drivers. Perfect for quick races, drifting challenges, or chasing your best lap time!

🏎️ Key Features

- Singleplayer Racing – Compete against AI opponents in exciting races.

- Multiple Tracks– Race across diverse environments, from city streets to winding hills.

- Arcade Drifting – Master the art of drift and push your skills to the limit.

- Time Trial Mode – Challenge yourself to set new records and climb the leaderboards.

- Full Controller Support – Enjoy smooth driving with gamepads, steering wheels, or keyboard.

- Low-Spec Friendly– Optimized to run smoothly on a wide range of PCs.

🎮 Gameplay

Choose your car, hit the track, and put your racing skills to the test! Each race brings different challenges, from sharp turns that demand precision drifting to straightaways that test your speed. Whether you’re a casual gamer or a racing enthusiast, you’ll find quick and fun races that keep you coming back for more.

🔥 Why You’ll Love It

- Easy to pick up, fun to master.

- Bright, colorful visuals designed for an arcade racing feel.

- Offline gameplay—no internet required to enjoy the full experience.

Are you ready to drift past the competition and cross the finish line first?

name: Drift Off

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Runs on low-spec PCs; stable 30 FPS on integrated graphics (Intel UHD 620 or better).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 1080p/60 FPS with medium-high settings.
